children: GoPro agreed to merge with Starman Optical, providing $285 million cash to shareholders and eliminating approximately $92 million of debt at closing.
GoPro will merge with Starman Optical; GoPro remains the surviving public company listed on Nasdaq.
Shareholders to receive $285 million aggregate cash, or $1.14 per share, subject to net working capital adjustment.
GoPro’s outstanding debt of about $92 million to be repaid in full at closing, leaving a substantially debt-free balance sheet.
Transaction expected to add U.S. onshore optical transceiver business and expand into AI data center, government, defense and aerospace markets.
Deal approved by both boards, expected to close by year-end 2026 subject to regulatory and stockholder approvals.
